checks.check: Spectrum quoted TAKE executes at Watson turn
Normal interface shows Watson leaving his chair and entering the hall with Holmes
Lestrade refuses WAIT and hails a cab with the original dialogue
Spectrum shows Lestrade boarding and ordering his destination; IL marker moves into the cab
Syntax error advances neither the clock nor NPC markers in Spectrum mode
Spectrum restart restores Watson and Lestrade to their initial positions at 08:00am
